cases.input: Four scoped pinned memberships and two declared evidenced dependencies.
cases.expect: Canonical query returns confirmed paths and an evidence-backed bounded coverage statement.

cases.input: P1 and P2 use F through current pins; P3 lacks a target pin.
cases.expect: P1 and P2 are confirmed, P3 stays target-unpinned in qualified paths, and gap questions request the missing coordinate.

cases.input: A dependency target has no immutable content digest.
cases.expect: The edge remains visible as target-unpinned, is excluded from confirmed paths and produces a gap question.

cases.input: A membership or dependency omits scopeVersionId.
cases.expect: The assertion is rejected and cannot enter traversal.

cases.input: One product has overlapping memberships with differing AISMM digests.
cases.expect: One unresolved conflict set cites both assertions and a resolution owner; no second product is created.

cases.input: One product has overlapping memberships with differing productVersionPin values.
cases.expect: The overlap is unresolved rather than hidden by the natural key.

cases.input: Two namespaced references resolve by evidence to the same master record.
cases.expect: The second membership is rejected as duplicate identity.

cases.input: An authoritative product has no AISMM context.
cases.expect: Membership remains visible with aismmRefAbsenceReason and appears only in qualified paths.

cases.input: A newer target digest appears after an edge was recorded.
cases.expect: Stored edge bytes remain unchanged and a later query derives pinned-stale.

cases.input: A dependency moves to a new target digest.
cases.expect: A successor with supersedesDependencyId is created and the predecessor remains reconstructible.

cases.input: Successor references form a cycle.
cases.expect: The cycle is rejected.

cases.input: A valid dependency ceases at t2.
cases.expect: It appears in historical queries before t2 and remains in the audit trail.

cases.input: An edge is retracted as erroneous.
cases.expect: It is excluded from world-time truth but retained with retraction evidence in record-time audit.

cases.input: Coverage says complete while a stale source or open boundary exists.
cases.expect: The statement is rejected.

cases.input: unknownBoundary is absent or empty.
cases.expect: Coverage is forced to unknown.

cases.input: A current enumerated complete source set yields no observed edges.
cases.expect: Coverage is zero observed; no zero-impact claim is made.

cases.input: An incompletely covered source set yields no observed edges.
cases.expect: Coverage is unknown, including for 0.1.0-legacy.

cases.input: A dependency omits assertionKind.
cases.expect: The assertion is rejected.

cases.input: An inferred edge has confidence 0.99.
cases.expect: It remains qualified and never becomes confirmed.

cases.input: A future edge exists only in a scenario.
cases.expect: It remains qualified unless scenario mode is explicit and is never current authoritative state.

cases.input: A backdated edge is recorded after an earlier result.
cases.expect: Replaying the same asOf and asAt reproduces the earlier digest; advancing asAt exposes the edge.

cases.input: A-B-C-A exists under visit-once.
cases.expect: Traversal terminates deterministically and records the cycle-policy exclusion.

cases.input: A result omits depthLimit or cyclePolicy.
cases.expect: The result is invalid.

cases.input: Two implementations receive identical unordered logical inputs.
cases.expect: After lexical UTF-8 ordering and RFC 8785 canonicalization they produce the same SHA-256 digest.

cases.input: The claimed source digest cannot be reproduced from a specified snapshot procedure.
cases.expect: The pin remains unverified-claimed and cannot support release provenance.

cases.input: A path contains evidence with stricter access than the landscape.
cases.expect: effectiveAccessCeiling equals the strictest contributing policy.

cases.input: The requester cannot know an edge exists.
cases.expect: No endpoint identifier is disclosed; only suppressedEdgeCount is returned and coverage is not complete.

cases.input: One query runs under two entitlement profiles.
cases.expect: Each profile has a stable digest and no equality is claimed across profiles.

cases.input: An edge uses uses-platform instead of an evidenced relation type.
cases.expect: The edge is rejected pending a registry-controlled vocabulary extension.

cases.input: A product replaces another through plmm.08.
cases.expect: A replaces edge is accepted and remains historically traversable.

cases.input: vr.wm-xct-039 is declared required while held.
cases.expect: The composition is rejected; only optional reference use is allowed.

cases.input: A layer has no findings, questions, artifacts, CRUD or roles.
cases.expect: It renders as declared-empty and emits no structural-completeness claim.

cases.input: Repository v0.1.0 draft is used to assign a runtime version.
cases.expect: The assignment is rejected.

cases.input: Publication is attempted while fixturesExecuted=false or a hold is open.
cases.expect: The publication gate refuses the release.

cases.input: A relation target uses modelId WM-XCT-039.
cases.expect: The relation is rejected; runtime id vr.wm-xct-039 is required.

cases.input: The landscape copies components, SBOMs, APIs or owners.
cases.expect: The duplicated product internals are rejected.

cases.input: A regional runtime instance is registered as a SoftwareProduct.
cases.expect: The identity split is rejected and the runtime stays external.
